page.layout: One printed page, single column of dictionary entries; running head "EX. FA." at top; page number 271 at top right; a centred letter heading "F." above the entries; catchword "Fa-" at bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Exul] Extorris à solo patriæ, Liv. Submotus patriâ, Ovid. Exclusus, Cic.
Exulare] Vagus & exul error, & undique exclusus. Insulari solitudine damnari, Amm. Proficisci exilium, Atti. apud Non. Ire exilium, Catul.

Exundare] Stagnat Nilus, Virg. Undat. Redundat lacus, Cic. Inundat. Exspatians lacus, Plin. Restagnat locus, Col. Refusus pontus, Virg. Superfusus Tiberis, Liv, Exspatiatum flumen, Ovid. Excessit alveum Tiberis, Plin. Iun.
Exuere] Exuere habitus regales, Stat. Hominem ex homine exuere. Ponere tunicam, Cic. Exsuvias facere, Plaut.
main_text.head: F.
main_text.p: Fabale] Fabalia, Scal. Fabulum, Lucil. Fabale acus. Fabales alæ. Fabaginum acus, Cat. Fabalis stipula. Culmen fabæ, Ovid. Scapi fabarum. Caules fabarum, Plin.
Fabalis] Fabarius, fabaginus, fabatus, Cat. Fabales, Cato. Scalig.
Fabula] Fabella. Apologus, Cic. Næniæ aniles, Iul. Cap. Fabularis historia, Suet. Mythistoria, Iul. Cap.
Fac ita esse, vid. Concedamus hoc.
Facile aliquid] Creare fastidium, Plin. Præstare tutum iter, Cic. Faxo, Ter. Effectum habere, Cæs. Habeo rem factam, Mart.
Facere aliquem talem vel talem] Reddere amicitiorem, otiosum, Cic.

page.notes: The letter F. heading is a large initial; the drop-cap F of "Faba" is joined to the word. Some Latin words are set in italic and roman in mixed fashion; reproduced as printed. Catchword "Fa-" at lower right.
